description: Produce a thorough release candidate PR to main. Validates state, checks merge conflicts, infers the version bump from commit history, and drafts a release-focused PR body. Trigger on requests like "cut a release", "cut an RC", "prep the release candidate", or "what version should this be". This fires only when a branch bundles multiple changes into a versioned release — for an ordinary single-change PR, use create-pr instead.
